THE PROCESS

Give an idea
its own rhythm.

A simple path from the first sketch
to the details that make it feel right.

01

Find the feeling.

Set the tone, materials and pace before adding detail.

02

Make it useful.

Build a clear structure. Keep ordinary navigation within reach.

03

Test the details.

Check the smaller screen, the slower device and the quieter mode.
